name: com.sadib.authlogin
description: Reusable PlayFab authentication package. Supports Google Account (LoginWithGoogleAccount) and Facebook / Instagram (LoginWithFacebook) via a single AuthManager API. Drop into any Unity Android project, assign your own AuthSettings, and call SignInWithGoogle(), SignInWithFacebook(), or SignInWithInstagram().

samples.description: Minimal Sign in with Google UI wired to AuthManager.
